title: JAK2/STAT3‑mediated dose‑dependent cytostatic and cytotoxic effects of sesquiterpene lactones from Gymnanthemum extensum on A549 human lung carcinoma cells.
authors: Keeratichamroen, Siriporn; Lirdprapamongkol, Kriengsak; Thongnest, Sanit; Boonsombat, Jutatip; Chawengrum, Pornsuda; Sornprachum, Thiwaree; Sirirak, Jitnapa; Verathamjamras, Chris; Ornnork, Narittira; Ruchirawat, Somsak; Svasti, Jisnuson
one_liner_zh: 该文研究倍半萜内酯通过JAK2/STAT3通路抑制肺癌细胞，分子对接仅针对JAK2蛋白，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Due to drug resistance and disease recurrence, lung cancer remains one of the primary cancer‑related causes of death in both men and women worldwide. In addition, lung cancer is clinically silent and thus most patients are at an advanced stage at the time of diagnosis. The limited efficiency of current conventional chemotherapies necessitates the search for novel effective anticancer agents. The present study demonstrated the anti‑proliferative effect and apoptosis‑inducing activity of three sesquiterpene lactones isolated from Gymnanthemum extensum, vernodalin (VDa), vernolepin (VLe) and vernolide (VLi), on A549 human lung cancer cells. Treatment with sub‑cytotoxic doses (cell viability remaining >75%) of VDa, VLe and VLi, arrested progression of the A549 cell cycle at the G(0)/G(1) phase, while cytotoxic doses of the three compounds induced G(2)/M phase arrest and apoptosis. Mechanistic studies revealed that VDa, VLe and VLi may exert their anti‑tumor activity through the JAK2/STAT3 pathway. Molecular docking analysis confirmed that VDa, VLe and VLi formed hydrogen bonds with the FERM domain of JAK2 protein. Overall, the present study highlighted the potential therapeutic value of VDa, VLe and VLi to be further developed as anticancer agents for the treatment of lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 由于耐药性和疾病复发，肺癌仍然是全球男性和女性中主要的癌症相关死亡原因之一。此外，肺癌在临床上无症状，因此大多数患者在诊断时已处于晚期。当前常规化疗药物的效率有限，亟需寻找新型有效的抗癌药物。本研究展示了从Gymnanthemum extensum中分离出的三种倍半萜内酯——vernodalin (VDa)、vernolepin (VLe)和vernolide (VLi)——对人肺癌A549细胞的抗增殖效应和诱导凋亡活性。使用亚细胞毒性剂量（细胞存活率>75%）的VDa、VLe和VLi处理，使A549细胞周期停滞在G(0)/G(1)期，而三种化合物的细胞毒性剂量则诱导G(2)/M期阻滞和凋亡。机制研究表明，VDa、VLe和VLi可能通过JAK2/STAT3通路发挥其抗肿瘤活性。分子对接分析证实，VDa、VLe和VLi与JAK2蛋白的FERM结构域形成氢键。总体而言，本研究强调了VDa、VLe和VLi作为抗癌药物进一步开发用于治疗肺癌的潜在治疗价值。
